title: Surreal Cosmic Sorceress
description: A woman with glowing yellow butterfly wings stands at the center of a fantastical scene, wearing a red and silver mirrored bodysuit with a golden zipper. She raises one hand toward a beam of light while surrounded by floating eyeballs, jellyfish-like creatures, melting clocks, red drapery, stone ruins, and a broken doorway revealing a glowing tower.
prompt: A mystical woman with large glowing yellow butterfly wings stands in the center of a surreal cosmic dreamscape, wearing a tight red and silver mirrored bodysuit with golden accents. She has closed eyes and a flower crown, one arm raised to a beam of light. Floating eyeballs, purple jellyfish, melting red clocks, stone ruins, red velvet drapery, and a shattered doorway revealing a glowing tower fill the scene.
